articles.title: The Dark Wood of the Golden Birds: Margaret Wise Brown’s Lost Masterpiece about Mortality and the Meaning of Life, Newly Illustrated
articles.highlight: 1948年9月初，在《晚安月亮》出版一年后，玛格丽特·怀斯·布朗看着一生挚爱渐渐走向生命终点。
articles.summary: 文章围绕玛格丽特·怀斯·布朗一部关于死亡与生命意义的失落杰作展开，并交代其背景：1948年9月，在《晚安月亮》出版一年后，她目睹挚爱迈克尔·斯特兰奇走向生命终点。文章也勾勒出斯特兰奇的鲜明形象：她原名布兰奇·奥尔里克斯，健谈、老练而自持，衣着与嗓音都极具个人风格。它值得读，是因为它把这位经典童书作者较少被谈论的生命观与情感经验带回公众视野。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：理解一位创作者，不能只看她最著名的作品；亲密关系的失去与对死亡的思考，可能同样构成其创作的重要底色。
articles.sourceExcerpt: In early September 1948, a year after she rewilded the landscape of literature with Goodnight Moon, Margaret Wise Brown watched the love of her life fade to black. Michael Strange, born Blanche Oelrichs, had cast an instant spell on Margaret — outspoken, sophisticated, and self-possessed, so tall Margaret had to lift her grey-blue eyes to meet the black of Michael’s, her tall frame clad in masculine clothing she herself had designed to cling to her curves, with a musical voice unspooling from her haunting dark beauty, a deep velvet laugh, and a reputation for rarely keeping a promise.

articles.title: Quoting Jason Koebler
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: Case study
articles.summary: Jason Koebler 指出，大科技平台缺乏客服、用户难以联系真人，导致人们把日常技术问题交给 ChatGPT。ChatGPT 越来越常告诉这些人，他们发现了具有新闻价值的事，并称 404 Media 能提供帮助。这展示了 AI 在替代客服入口时可能给出误导性建议，也凸显平台支持缺位带来的连锁影响。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键约束是：当平台客服缺位时，用户会把 ChatGPT 当作求助入口，而模型可能把普通技术问题误判为新闻线索并给出错误指向。
articles.highlight: 大科技平台几乎没有客服，用户无法联系到真人，许多人因此转向 ChatGPT 处理普通技术问题。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Because big tech platforms essentially do not have customer support and make it impossible for their users to contact a human, many people experiencing run-of-the-mill tech problems have turned to ChatGPT. And, increasingly, ChatGPT is telling people that have normal tech support problems that they have discovered something journalistically notable and that 404 Media, specifically, can help them. — Jason Koebler , ChatGPT Keeps Telling People 404 Media Can Solve Their Tech Support Problems Tags: jason-koebler , openai , journalism , ai , llms , ai-ethics , ai-misuse , generative-ai , chatgpt , 404-media

en.highlight: Because big tech platforms essentially do not have customer support and make it impossible for their users to contact a human, many people with ordinary tech problems turn to ChatGPT.
en.summary: Jason Koebler points out that big tech platforms lack customer support and make it hard for users to reach a human, so people hand everyday tech problems to ChatGPT. Increasingly, ChatGPT tells these people they have found something newsworthy and that 404 Media can help. This shows how AI can give misleading guidance when it fills the support gap, and how the absence of platform support creates knock-on effects.
en.failureAnalysis: The key constraint is that when platform support is missing, users treat ChatGPT as a help desk, and the model may mistake ordinary tech problems for news tips and point them in the wrong direction.
en.title: ChatGPT Is Being Used for Tech Support and Points People to 404 Media
